title: SDRF (Sample and Data Relationship Format) | SDRF-Proteomics
why_relevant: Defines the SDRF-Proteomics concept and helps interpret column intent/semantics when generating submission tables.
extracted_technique: Use schema-driven extraction: restrict outputs to known SDRF fields and prefer verbatim spans; treat missing as Not Applicable.
takeaway: Ground the pipeline in the SDRF schema so the model only emits allowed fields and values; schema constraints reduce invalid outputs and improve precision.

title: 1rgs/jsonformer
why_relevant: Provides a practical approach to forcing LLM outputs into JSON that conforms to a schema, reducing parse failures in production pipelines.
extracted_technique: Schema-constrained JSON generation (fixed tokens for structure, generate only content slots) to produce reliably parseable structured outputs.
takeaway: Constrained structured generation is a strong guardrail when the submission requires strict column-keyed JSON/table outputs; it reduces brittle regex parsing.

title: UIEPrompter: Universal Information Extraction using Schema-driven Prompting and Constrained Output Generation
why_relevant: Directly relevant evidence that schema-driven prompting plus constrained output improves robustness for document-level information extraction tasks like this competition.
extracted_technique: Universal IE via (1) schema-driven prompts, (2) constrained decoding/structured output, (3) task-agnostic prompting templates.
query: UIEPrompter universal information extraction schema-driven prompting constrained output generation
takeaway: Treat SDRF extraction as schema-filling IE; use constrained/structured outputs and schema prompts to reduce hallucination and stabilize end-to-end extraction.

title: guidance-ai/guidance
why_relevant: Demonstrates practical constraint mechanisms (regex/CFG/JSON-schema-like patterns) to control LLM output format, which is crucial for reliable CSV/JSON emission.
extracted_technique: Constrained generation and validation loops: generate under constraints; reject/repair invalid outputs; fall back to deterministic heuristics.
takeaway: A constraint-first generation strategy prevents pipeline breakage from invalid JSON and enables robust fallback/repair without manual intervention.
